## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link any related issue.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. For model/runtime changes, include
real conversion, inference and numerical-validation evidence.

## Review

- [ ] The change stays within the supported scope or documents its new scope.
- [ ] Relevant tests, docs and generated API types are updated.
- [ ] Numerical policies and safety checks have not been weakened to pass tests.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, downloaded weights or generated environments are included.
